messages:
Elaine: ACME sent a security checklist and wants a BYO-key option + perf numbers. Asking to start a POC next week, can we confirm feasibility and a rough price delta?

Mike_SE: quick q's — 1) will they run CloudHSM or on-prem Thales? 2) expected QPS / TPS and avg prompt length? 3) tolerance for extra per-request latency?

Elaine: they're on-prem Thales. target ~200 TPS (mostly short prompts, < 256 tokens). they care about token-level latency; asked whether we can rotate CMKs w/ no downtime.

Carol_Security: short answers: we support customer-managed keys via a proxy to their HSM. rotation without downtime is possible with a dual-key swap pattern (provision new key material, mirror writes, switch alias). will draft a mini-runbook.

Carol_Security: firewall / handshake snippet and example call:
```
# network preflight (customer edge)
allow out tcp 443 to redwood-proxy.acme.internal (10.12.34.0/24)
allow out tcp 443 to acme-hsm-gw.example.com

# sample KMS proxy use (server side)
curl -H 'Authorization: Bearer <REDACTED>' \
  -X POST https://redwood.example.com/v1/keystore/decrypt \
  -d '{"ciphertext":"<base64>"}'
```

Jason_ACME: we need SLA on rotation window <= 5 minutes and a failover plan. what is the cost delta for HSM-backed BYO vs Redwood-managed CMK? also need signed audit logs shipped to our S3.

Mike_SE: ballpark: HSM-backed BYO is ~+20-30% on per-token cost due to extra network hops + proxying, plus a one-time integration fee (engineering + network setup). precise quote after we validate egress volumes. audit: we can stream signed logs / attestation to your S3 or syslog collector.

Elaine: Legal flagged indemnity language around key compromise. Amy_legal — FYI they'll expect contract addendum, likely 2 week review. also need SOC2 + FIPS cert excerpts in the packet.

Amy_Legal: noted. I'll prepare a redline for the key-compromise clause and pull our SOC2 and FIPS references. expect ~10 business days to finalize changes.

Carol_Security: paste of a standard questionnaire answer we give customers: 
"Redwood supports customer-managed keys via a key-proxy. Key material never persists in plaintext in Redwood control plane. All cryptographic operations that require secret keying material are executed in the customer's HSM or via a secure proxy session. We provide attestations and signed audit trails on request."

Mike_SE: proposed POC plan (high level):
- Day 0: network whitelist + key-proxy cert exchange
- Day 1: handshake + smoke decrypt/encrypt tests
- Day 2: ramp to 200 TPS (load test) with latency sampling
- Day 3: failure injection (HSM disconnect, rotate key)
Need ACME infra lead on a call tomorrow 11:00am PST to kick off.

Jason_ACME: tomorrow 11 works. one more: do you support daily rotation for ephemeral DEKs? we want auto rotation every 24h.

Carol_Security: yes — daily automated DEK rotation is supported. master CMK rotation is customer-controlled; we recommend dual-write + alias swap to avoid downtime. we'll provide a sample automation script.

Mike_SE: preliminary pricing to include: one-time integration ~$15k, monthly platform +25% on token unit price for HSM BYO path. will firm up after we confirm egress and sustained TPS.

devops-bot: Deployed branch se/keystore-proxy v1.3 to staging :white_check_mark:

Elaine: great. i'll send calendar invite and attach the questionnaire answers + attestation docs. @amy_legal please start contract redline. @mike_se can you produce a short slide with the POC runbook and rough pricing by EOD?

Mike_SE: yep, i'll drop a 2-slide deck and the numbers by EOD.
